object.name: session_core_manager
object.description: Unprivileged read-only interface for observing sessions and users.

s2c.name: session_added
s2c.description: Sent when a session is created, and once for each existing active session when the manager is created.

s2c.name: user_added
s2c.description: Sent when a user becomes known, and once for each known user when the manager is created. Includes users that are lingering without an active session.

c2s.name: get_session_by_id
c2s.description: Initial fields are followed by done. If the session does not exist, destroyed is sent instead.

c2s.name: get_session_by_pid

description.summary: create a per-session info object by process PID

c2s.description: Selects the session containing the process. Initial fields are followed by done. If no matching session exists, destroyed is sent instead.

arg.name: pid
arg.summary: process PID of the session to query

c2s.name: get_session

description.summary: create a per-session info object for the calling process

c2s.description: Selects the session containing the connecting client, identified from the connection's peer credentials rather than a client-supplied PID. Initial fields are followed by done. If no matching session exists, destroyed is sent instead.

c2s.name: get_display_session_by_uid

description.summary: create an info object for a user's preferred active session

c2s.description: Selects the oldest active session of class user belonging to the given UID. Age is determined by the session start timestamp, with the lowest session ID breaking ties. The selected session may be graphical or a TTY session. Initial fields are followed by done. If no matching session exists, destroyed is sent instead.

arg.name: uid
arg.summary: user ID of the session to query

c2s.name: get_user
c2s.description: Initial fields are followed by done. If the UID does not correspond to a known user, failed is sent and no user fields follow.

object.name: session_core_session
object.description: Provides information about a single session. All fields are pushed immediately on creation and re-sent if they change.

arg.name: leader
arg.summary: PID of the session-creating process, or 0 if unknown

arg.name: timestamp
arg.summary: session start time (seconds since Unix epoch)

arg.name: is_local
arg.summary: non-zero if the session originates from the local machine, zero if remote

arg.name: remote_host
arg.summary: remote host name, empty for local sessions

description.summary: session has ended or did not exist

s2c.name: terminate_failed
s2c.description: Sent when the caller does not have permission to terminate this session.

s2c.name: kill_failed
s2c.description: Sent when the caller does not have permission to kill this session.

s2c.name: lock_failed
s2c.description: Sent when the caller does not have permission to lock this session.

s2c.name: unlock_failed
s2c.description: Sent when the caller does not have permission to unlock this session.

description.summary: send SIGTERM to all processes in the session
forcibly kill all processes in the session via cgroup.kill

s2c.name: can_modify
s2c.description: Non-zero if this client may lock, unlock, terminate, or kill this session.

arg.name: can_modify
arg.summary: non-zero if mutating requests are allowed

arg.name: who
arg.summary: application or component holding the inhibitor

description.summary: inhibitor was released or did not exist

object.name: session_core_user
object.description: Provides information about a single user, identified by uid. All fields are pushed immediately on creation, followed by done.

arg.name: lingering
arg.summary: non-zero if the user has lingering enabled

s2c.name: state
s2c.description: Reflects whether the user currently has sessions and whether any of them is in the foreground, combined with the lingering flag. Re-sent whenever it changes.

s2c.name: failed
s2c.description:
Sent when the UID passed to get_user does not correspond to a known user.
No further events will be sent.

s2c.name: terminate_failed
s2c.description: Sent when the caller does not have permission to terminate this user.

s2c.name: kill_failed
s2c.description: Sent when the caller does not have permission to kill this user.

s2c.name: can_modify
s2c.description: Non-zero if this client may terminate or kill this user's sessions.

arg.name: can_modify
arg.summary: non-zero if mutating requests are allowed

value.name: offline
value.summary: no sessions and lingering disabled

value.name: lingering
value.summary: no sessions but lingering enabled

value.name: online
value.summary: has a session, none in the foreground

value.name: active
value.summary: has a session in the foreground

value.name: closing
value.summary: has sessions, all of them closing

value.name: online
value.summary: session is logged in but not in the foreground

value.name: active
value.summary: session is in the foreground

value.name: closing
value.summary: session is being destroyed

value.name: opening
value.summary: session is being created

value.name: user
value.summary: interactive login session owned by a user

value.name: greeter
value.summary: login prompt or display manager session

value.name: lock_screen
value.summary: screen locker session associated with an existing login

value.name: background
value.summary: non-interactive user session without an attached seat or VT

value.name: background_light
value.summary: lightweight background session excluded from idle shutdown accounting

value.name: manager
value.summary: per-user service manager session

value.name: manager_early
value.summary: early per-user service manager session created before a regular login

value.name: unkown
value.summary: session whose type could not be determined

value.name: block
value.summary: block the operation

value.name: block_weak
value.summary: block unprivileged operations requested by other users

value.name: delay
value.summary: delay the operation
